verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse docs say it handles forms with handwriting and that each parsed element carries a confidence score, which covers the core of recognizing handwritten fields and signaling uncertainty. The support rests on a single docs line, though. Annotations are never mentioned, confidence is documented only for Parse elements rather than Extract fields, and there is no explicit low-confidence flagging. Missing for 10: explicit annotation recognition, per-field confidence or uncertainty flags in Extract output, handwriting accuracy detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, handwritten fields and annotations are recognized and extracted, flagged with confidence when uncertain

citations.quote: Each element includes its type, page position, and confidence score. Parse handles multi-column text, nested tables, forms with handwriting, rotated pages
Reducto returns values matching that schema, handling OCR, layout detection, and LLM-based field location under the hood.
